translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Niezuo Age Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先個個柘，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Gege Zhe, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Gege Zhe submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 熱霧寨土百戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Rewu Stockade native tusi of hundreds; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Rewu Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先甲槓他，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Jiagang Ta, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Jiagang Ta submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓘眉喜寨土千戶，系倮夷種類。

translations.literal: Guanmeixi Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Nuosu Yi stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Guanmeixi Stockade was of Nuosu Yi stock.

sentences.zh: 其先官布笑，雍正四年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Guanbu Xiao, in the 4th year of Yongzheng, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Guanbu Xiao submitted in the 4th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 毛革阿按寨土千戶，系倮夷種類。

translations.literal: Maoge An Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Nuosu Yi stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Maoge An Stockade was of Nuosu Yi stock.

sentences.zh: 其先王乍，雍正四年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Wangzha, in the 4th year of Yongzheng, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Wangzha submitted in the 4th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 包子寺寨土千戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Baozisi Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Baozisi Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先噶竹，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Gazhu, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Gazhu submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上松潘廳中營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Middle Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Middle Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 阿思峒寨土千戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Asitong Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Asitong Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先立架，順治十五年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Lijia, in the 15th year of Shunzhi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Lijia submitted in the 15th year of Shunzhi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 羊峒寨土百戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Yangtong Stockade native tusi of hundreds; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Yangtong Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先甲利，雍正二年，歸附，授職，由四川總督給以土百戶委牌一張。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Jiali, in the 2nd year of Yongzheng, submitted and was granted office; the Sichuan governor-general issued one commission plaque for native tusi of hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Jiali submitted in the 2nd year of Yongzheng and received appointment; the Sichuan governor-general granted a commission as native headman of hundreds.

sentences.zh: 以上松潘廳左營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Left Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Left Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 下泥巴寨土百戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Xianiba Stockade native tusi of hundreds; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Xianiba Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先林青，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職，由四川總督給以土百戶委牌一張。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Linqing, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office; the Sichuan governor-general issued one commission plaque for native tusi of hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Linqing submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment; the Sichuan governor-general granted a commission as native headman of hundreds.

sentences.zh: 松潘廳右營屬。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Right Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Right Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 寒盻寨土千戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Hanpan Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Hanpan Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先占巴笑，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Zhanba Xiao, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Zhanba Xiao submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 商巴寨土千戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Shangba Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Shangba Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先剛讓笑，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Gangrang Xiao, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Gangrang Xiao submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 祈命寨土千戶，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Qiming Stockade native tusi of thousands; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Qiming Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先龍盻架，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Longpan Jia, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Longpan Jia submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 羊峒踏藏寨土目，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Yangtong Tazang Stockade native tusu; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman at Yangtong Tazang Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先甲六笑，康熙四十二年，歸附，授土目。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Jialiu Xiao, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted the office of native tusu.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Jialiu Xiao submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and was appointed native headman.

sentences.zh: 阿按寨土目，系西番種類。

translations.literal: An Stockade native tusu; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman at An Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先六笑他，康熙四十二年，歸附，授土目。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Liuxiao Ta, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted the office of native tusu.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Liuxiao Ta submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and was appointed native headman.

sentences.zh: 挖藥寨土目，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Wayao Stockade native tusu; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman at Wayao Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先旦折笑，康熙四十二年，歸附，授土目。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Danzhe Xiao, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted the office of native tusu.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Danzhe Xiao submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and was appointed native headman.

sentences.zh: 押頓寨土目，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Yadun Stockade native tusu; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman at Yadun Stockade was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先拈爭笑，康熙四十二年，歸附，授土目。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Nianzheng Xiao, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted and was granted the office of native tusu.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Nianzheng Xiao submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and was appointed native headman.

sentences.zh: 中岔寨土目，系西番種類。

translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Qigu submitted in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Pingfan Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.

translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains held patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 中羊峒隆康寨首，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Middle Yangdong Longkang Stockade chief; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The stockade chief of Middle Yangdong Longkang was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先林柱，雍正二年，歸附，委以寨首。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Linzhu, in the 2nd year of Yongzheng, submitted and was entrusted as stockade chief.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Linzhu submitted in the 2nd year of Yongzheng and was appointed stockade chief.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十一年，歐利娃作亂，陷南坪營，同治四年，周達武率武字、果毅各軍討平之。

translations.literal: In the 11th year of Xianfeng, Oliwa raised rebellion and captured Nanping Battalion; in the 4th year of Tongzhi, Zhou Dawu led the Wuzi and Guoyi armies to suppress and pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: In the 11th year of Xianfeng, Oliwa rebelled and seized Nanping Battalion; in the 4th year of Tongzhi, Zhou Dawu led the Wuzi and Guoyi forces to put down the uprising.

sentences.zh: 下羊峒黑角郎寨首，系西番種類。

translations.literal: Lower Yangdong Heijiaolang Stockade chief; of Western Tibetan stock.
translations.idiomatic: The stockade chief of Lower Yangdong Heijiaolang was of Western Tibetan stock.

sentences.zh: 其先六孝，雍正二年，歸附，委以寨首。

translations.literal: Their ancestor Liuxiao, in the 2nd year of Yongzheng, submitted and was entrusted as stockade chief.
translations.idiomatic: Their forebear Liuxiao submitted in the 2nd year of Yongzheng and was appointed stockade chief.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆無印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains held no sealed patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: None of the above native chieftains held sealed patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上松潘廳南坪營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Nanping Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Nanping Battalion of Songpan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 大姓寨土百戶，其先鬱氏，於唐時頒給左都督職銜印信，管束番眾。

translations.literal: Daxing Stockade native tusi of hundreds; their forebears the Yu clan, in Tang times, were issued the office title and seal of Left Commander-in-Chief to govern the fan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Daxing Stockade descended from the Yu clan, who in Tang times received the Left Commander-in-Chief title and seal to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治六年，郁孟賢將唐時印信呈繳。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Yu Mengxian surrendered the Tang-era seal for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Yu Mengxian presented and surrendered the Tang-era seal.

sentences.zh: 小姓寨土百戶，其先郁從文，於明末歸附，授長官司職銜印信，管束番衆。

translations.literal: Xiaoxing Stockade native tusi of hundreds; their forebear Yu Congwen, at the end of Ming, submitted and was granted the office title and seal of native prefect, to govern the fan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Xiaoxing Stockade descended from Yu Congwen, who submitted at the end of the Ming and received the native prefect title and seal to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，將明時印信號紙呈繳。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era seal and patent documents were surrendered for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era seal and patent documents were presented and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 大定沙壩土千戶，其先蘇忠，於明萬曆年間歸附，授土千戶職銜印信，管束番眾。

translations.literal: Dading Shaba native tusi of thousands; their forebear Su Zhong, during the Wanli reign of Ming, submitted and was granted the office title and seal of native tusi of thousands to govern the fan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of thousands at Dading Shaba descended from Su Zhong, who submitted during the Wanli reign of the Ming and received the native tusi of thousands title and seal to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，將明時印信號紙呈繳。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era seal and patent documents were surrendered for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era seal and patent documents were presented and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were each issued patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 大黑水寨土百戶，其先郁孟賢，於明末歸附，授土百戶職銜，管束各番。

translations.literal: Daheishui Stockade native tusi of hundreds; their forebear Yu Mengxian, at the end of Ming, submitted and was granted the office title of native tusi of hundreds to govern the various fan.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Daheishui Stockade descended from Yu Mengxian, who submitted at the end of the Ming and received the native tusi of hundreds title to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，將明時號紙呈繳。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era patent documents were surrendered for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, the Ming-era patent documents were presented and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 小黑水寨土百戶，其先於唐時歸附，授土百戶職銜印信，管束各番。

translations.literal: Xiaoheishui Stockade native tusi of hundreds; their forebears in Tang times submitted and were granted the office title and seal of native tusi of hundreds to govern the various fan.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Xiaoheishui Stockade descended from ancestors who submitted in Tang times and received the native tusi of hundreds title and seal to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，鬱從學將唐時印信呈繳。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, Yu Congxue surrendered the Tang-era seal for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, Yu Congxue presented and surrendered the Tang-era seal.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆給委牌。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were each granted commission plaques.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued commission plaques.

sentences.zh: 松坪寨土百戶，其先韓騰，於明末歸附，授土百戶職銜印信，管束番眾。

translations.literal: Songping Stockade native tusi of hundreds; their forebear Han Teng, at the end of Ming, submitted and was granted the office title and seal of native tusi of hundreds to govern the fan peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of hundreds at Songping Stockade descended from Han Teng, who submitted at the end of the Ming and received the native tusi of hundreds title and seal to rule over the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，將明末印信號紙呈繳，仍頒給號紙。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, the late-Ming seal and patent documents were surrendered for presentation, and patent documents were still issued.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, the late-Ming seal and patent documents were presented and surrendered, and new patent documents were issued in their place.

sentences.zh: 以上茂州疊溪營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Diexi Battalion of Maozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Diexi Battalion of Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 靜州長官司，其先董正伯，自唐時歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Jingzhou native prefect; their forebear Dong Zhengbo, from Tang times, submitted and was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Jingzhou descended from Dong Zhengbo, who submitted in Tang times and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 順治年間，賊屠茂州，土司董懷德率土兵捍禦，地方寧謐。

translations.literal: During the Shunzhi reign, bandits slaughtered Maozhou; the native chieftain Dong Huaide led native troops in defense, and the region was kept tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, when bandits ravaged Maozhou, the native chieftain Dong Huaide led his native troops in its defense and kept the region at peace.

sentences.zh: 九年，董應詔歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year, Dong Yingzhao submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year, Dong Yingzhao submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 隴木長官司，其先何文貴，於宋時剿羅打鼓生番有功，授職與印。

translations.literal: Longmu native prefect; their forebear He Wengui, in Song times, had merit in suppressing the raw fan of Luodagu and was granted office and a seal.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Longmu descended from He Wengui, who earned distinction in Song times for suppressing the raw tribes of Luodagu and received office and a seal.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 嶽希長官司，其先坤蒲，自唐時有功授職。

translations.literal: Yuexi native prefect; their forebear Kunpu, from Tang times, received office for merit.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Yuexi descended from Kunpu, who received appointment in Tang times for distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Kangxi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Kangxi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 沙壩安撫司，其先蟒答兒，自明時剿黑水三溪生番有功授職。

translations.literal: Shaba Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Mangdaer, from Ming times, received office for merit in suppressing the raw fan of Heishui Sanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Shaba descended from Mangdaer, who received appointment in Ming times for distinguished service in suppressing the raw tribes of Heishui Sanxi.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 水草坪巡檢土司，其先蟒答兒次子住水草坪，授巡檢職。

translations.literal: Shuicaoping native inspecting censor; their forebear was the second son of Mangdaer, who dwelt at Shuicaoping and was granted the office of inspecting censor.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspecting censor of Shuicaoping descended from the second son of Mangdaer, who settled at Shuicaoping and received appointment as inspecting censor.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 竹木坎副巡檢土司，其先坤兒布，自明時授職。

translations.literal: Zhumukan deputy native inspecting censor; their forebear Kunerbu, from Ming times, was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy native inspecting censor of Zhumukan descended from Kunerbu, who received appointment in Ming times.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 牟托巡檢土司，其先燦沙，自唐時授職。

translations.literal: Mutuo native inspecting censor; their forebear Cansha, from Tang times, was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspecting censor of Mutuo descended from Cansha, who received appointment in Tang times.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, they submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were each issued seals and patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains held sealed patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 實大關副長官司，其先官之保，自明時授職。

translations.literal: Shidaguan deputy native prefect; their forebear Guanzhibao, from Ming times, was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy native prefect of Shidaguan descended from Guanzhibao, who received appointment in Ming times.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，歸附，頒給號紙。

translations.literal: In the 10th year of Kangxi, they submitted and were issued patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the 10th year of Kangxi, they submitted allegiance and received patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上茂州茂州營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Maozhou Battalion of Maozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Maozhou Battalion of Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 陽地隘口土長官司，始祖王行儉，由宋寧宗朝授龍州判官，世襲。

translations.literal: Yangdi'aikou native prefect; the founding ancestor Wang Xingjian, in the reign of Emperor Ningzong of Song, was appointed magistrate of Longzhou, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Yangdi'aikou traced its line to the founding ancestor Wang Xingjian, who in the reign of Emperor Ningzong of Song was appointed magistrate of Longzhou in a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 傳三世，改守禦千戶。

translations.literal: After three generations, the office was changed to garrison commander of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: After three generations, the post was changed to garrison commander of thousands.

sentences.zh: 元至正間，授宣禦副使。

translations.literal: Between the Zhizheng years of Yuan, the office of vice commissioner of pacification was granted.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhizheng era of Yuan, the vice commissioner of pacification was conferred.

sentences.zh: 明洪武七年，開龍州，改長官司。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, Longzhou was opened and the office was changed to native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, Longzhou was established and the office was redesignated as native prefect.

sentences.zh: 順治六年，王冫各歸附，仍授原職，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Wang Ge submitted, was still granted the original office, and was issued a seal and patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Wang Ge submitted allegiance, retained his original office, and received sealed patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 土通判，明洪武七年授王思恭為長官司，以王思民襲判官，旋授宣撫僉事。

translations.literal: Native subprefect; in the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, Wang Sigong was appointed native prefect, Wang Simin succeeded as subprefect magistrate, and soon the office of pacification commissioner was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The native subprefect: in the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, Wang Sigong was appointed native prefect; Wang Simin inherited the subprefect magistracy, and soon received appointment as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，改土通判。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing reign, the office was changed to native subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, the post was redesignated as native subprefect.

sentences.zh: 順治六年，王啟睿歸附，仍授原職，頒給號紙，無印信。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Wang Qirui submitted, was still granted the original office, and was issued patent documents of office, without a seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Wang Qirui submitted allegiance, retained his original office, and received patent documents of appointment, but no seal.

sentences.zh: 龍溪堡土知事，宋景定間，授薛嚴龍州知州，世襲。

translations.literal: Longxibao native registrar; between the Jingding years of Song, Xue Yan was appointed prefect of Longzhou, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The native registrar of Longxibao: during the Jingding era of Song, Xue Yan was appointed prefect of Longzhou in a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 明隆慶間，改土知事。

translations.literal: During the Longqing reign of Ming, the office was changed to native registrar.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longqing reign of Ming, the post was redesignated as native registrar.

sentences.zh: 順治六年，薛兆選歸附，仍授原職，頒給號紙。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Xue Zhaoxuan submitted, was still granted the original office, and was issued patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Shunzhi, Xue Zhaoxuan submitted allegiance, retained his original office, and received patent documents of appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上龍安府龍安營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Long'an Battalion of Long'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Long'an Battalion of Long'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瓦寺宣慰司，先世雍中羅洛思，與兄桑郎納思壩，前明納貢土物。

translations.literal: Wasi Pacification Commissioner; in former generations Yongzhong Luoluosi, together with his elder brother Sanglang Nasiba, in the former Ming presented tribute of native products.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Wasi: in earlier generations Yongzhong Luoluosi and his elder brother Sanglang Nasiba had presented tribute of local goods to the Ming court.

sentences.zh: 正統六年，威茂、孟董、九子、黑虎等寨諸番跳樑，雍中羅洛思、桑郎納思壩奉調出藏，帶兵出力，即留住汶川縣塗禹山，給宣慰司印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Zhengtong, the fan of Weimao, Mengdong, Jiuzi, Heihu, and other stockades rose in rebellion; Yongzhong Luoluosi and Sanglang Nasiba, on imperial summons, came out of Tibet, brought troops and exerted effort, and were then retained at Tuyu Mountain in Wenchuan County and granted the seal and patent documents of Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Zhengtong, when the tribes of Weimao, Mengdong, Jiuzi, Heihu, and other stockades rebelled, Yongzhong Luoluosi and Sanglang Nasiba answered the imperial summons from Tibet, marched with their troops, and were then settled at Tuyu Mountain in Wenchuan County and granted the Pacification Commissioner seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，土司曲翊伸歸附，授安撫司。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Qu Yishen submitted and was granted the office of Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Qu Yishen submitted allegiance and received appointment as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十九年，征西藏，土司桑郎溫愷隨征有功，加宣慰司銜。

translations.literal: In the 59th year of Kangxi, on the campaign against Tibet, the native chieftain Sanglang Wenkai followed the expedition with merit and was promoted to the title of Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the 59th year of Kangxi, during the campaign against Tibet, the native chieftain Sanglang Wenkai served with distinction and was elevated to the Pacification Commissioner title.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，加指揮使職銜。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Qianlong, the office title of commander was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the 2nd year of Qianlong, the commander title was conferred.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年及三十六年，征剿雜谷土司蒼旺並金川等處，土司桑郎雍中隨征出力，賞戴花翎。

translations.literal: In the 17th and 36th years of Qianlong, on campaigns to suppress the native chieftain Cangwang of Zagun and places such as Jinchuan, the native chieftain Sanglang Yongzhong followed the expeditions and exerted effort, and was rewarded with the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 17th and 36th years of Qianlong, during campaigns against the native chieftain Cangwang of Zagun and the Jinchuan region, the native chieftain Sanglang Yongzhong served on campaign and was rewarded with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，隨征達州教匪，經四川總督勒保奏升宣慰司，換給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Jiaqing, on campaign against the Dazhou sect rebels, through memorial by Sichuan Governor-General Le Bao he was promoted to Pacification Commissioner and reissued a seal and patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Jiaqing, while campaigning against the Dazhou sect rebels, he was promoted to Pacification Commissioner on memorial of Sichuan Governor-General Le Bao and received a new seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 以上理番廳維州協左營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Left Battalion of the Weizhou Brigade of Lifan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Left Battalion of the Weizhou Brigade of Lifan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 梭磨宣慰使司，始祖囊素沙甲布，原系雜穀土目，自唐時歸附。

translations.literal: Suomo Pacification Commissioner; the founding ancestor Nangsu Shajiabu, originally a native tusu of Zagun, submitted from Tang times.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Suomo traced its line to the founding ancestor Nangsu Shajiabu, originally a native headman of Zagun, who had submitted in Tang times.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，征剿郭克賊番有功，頒給副長官司印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Yongzheng, for merit in campaigning against the bandit fan of Guoke, the seal and patent documents of deputy native prefect were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Yongzheng, for distinguished service in suppressing the rebel tribes of Guoke, sealed patent documents of deputy native prefect were issued.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年，換給安撫司印。

translations.literal: In the 15th year of Qianlong, the seal of Pacification Commissioner was reissued.
translations.idiomatic: In the 15th year of Qianlong, a new Pacification Commissioner seal was issued.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，進剿大小金川，土司隨征，經將軍阿桂奏賞宣慰司職銜並花翎，換給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 36th year, on the campaign to suppress Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, the native chieftain followed the expedition; through General Agui's memorial he was rewarded with the Pacification Commissioner title and peacock feather, and reissued seal and patent documents of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the 36th year, during the campaign against Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, the native chieftain served on campaign; on General Agui's memorial he was rewarded with the Pacification Commissioner title and peacock feather and received a new seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 卓克基長官司，其祖良爾吉，系雜穀土舍。

translations.literal: Zhuokeji native prefect; their ancestor Liangerji was a native tusu of Zagun.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Zhuokeji descended from Liangerji, a native tusu of Zagun.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，隨征大金川有功。

translations.literal: In the 13th year of Qianlong, merit in following the expedition against Greater Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the 13th year of Qianlong he served with distinction on the campaign against Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，頒給長官司印信號紙，尋以通匪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the 15th year, the seal and patent documents of native prefect were issued; soon after, for communicating with bandits, he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the 15th year he received the native prefect seal and patent documents, but was soon executed for colluding with bandits.

sentences.zh: 松岡長官司，其祖系雜穀土目，自唐時安設。

translations.literal: Songgang native prefect; their ancestors were native tusu of Zagun, established from Tang times.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Songgang descended from native headmen of Zagun, an office established in Tang times.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年，頒給安撫司印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 22nd year of Kangxi, the seal and patent documents of Pacification Commissioner were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the 22nd year of Kangxi the Pacification Commissioner seal and patent documents were issued.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年，土司蒼旺不法，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the 17th year of Qianlong, the native chieftain Cangwang acted unlawfully and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the 17th year of Qianlong the native chieftain Cangwang broke the law and was executed.

sentences.zh: 黨壩長官司，其曾祖阿丕，系雜穀土舍。

translations.literal: Dangba native prefect; their great-grandfather Api was a native tusu of Zagun.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Dangba traced its line to the great-grandfather Api, a native tusu of Zagun.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，土舍澤旺隨征大金川有功，頒給長官司印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 13th year of Qianlong, the native tusu Zewang followed the expedition against Greater Jinchuan with merit and was issued the seal and patent documents of native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the 13th year of Qianlong the native tusu Zewang served with distinction on the Greater Jinchuan campaign and received the native prefect seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，土司更噶斯丹增姜初隨征苗匪，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Jiaqing, the native chieftain Gengasidanzeng Jiangchu followed the expedition against Miao bandits and was rewarded with the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Jiaqing the native chieftain Gengasidanzeng Jiangchu served on campaign against Miao rebels and was rewarded with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 以上理番廳維州協右營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Right Battalion of the Weizhou Brigade of Lifan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Right Battalion of the Weizhou Brigade of Lifan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 沃日安撫司，始祖巴碧太。

translations.literal: Wori Pacification Commissioner; founding ancestor Babita.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Wori traced its line to the founding ancestor Babita.

sentences.zh: 順治十五年，歸附，頒發沃日貫頂淨慈妙智國師印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 15th year of Shunzhi, submitted allegiance and was issued the seal and patent documents of the Wo'ri Crowned Pure Compassionate Wisdom National Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the 15th year of Shunzhi he submitted allegiance and received the seal and patent documents of the Wo'ri Crowned Pure Compassionate Wisdom National Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，頒給土司色達拉安撫司印信號紙，隨將舊印呈繳。

translations.literal: In the 20th year of Qianlong, the native chieftain Sedala was issued the seal and patent documents of Pacification Commissioner, and the old seal was surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the 20th year of Qianlong the native chieftain Sedala received the Pacification Commissioner seal and patent documents and surrendered the old seal.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，隨征金川有功，賞二品頂戴花翎。

translations.literal: In the 29th year, merit in following the expedition against Jinchuan; rewarded with a second-rank cap ornament and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 29th year he served with distinction on the Jinchuan campaign and was rewarded with a second-rank cap ornament and peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 沃日地名更為鄂克什，原系維州協所轄。

translations.literal: The place name Wori was changed to Ekeshi; originally under the jurisdiction of the Weizhou Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: The place name Wori was changed to Ekeshi; it had originally fallen under the Weizhou Brigade.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，改隸懋功協管轄。

translations.literal: In the 50th year of Qianlong, jurisdiction was transferred to the Maogong Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In the 50th year of Qianlong its jurisdiction was transferred to the Maogong Brigade.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 綽斯甲布宣撫司，綽斯甲布印文曰「卓斯甲布」。

translations.literal: Chuosijiabu Pacification Commissioner; the seal inscription of Chuosijiabu reads "Zhuosijiabu."
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Chuosijiabu bore a seal inscribed "Zhuosijiabu."

sentences.zh: 卓斯，地名。

translations.literal: Zhuosi is a place name.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuosi is a place name.

sentences.zh: 甲者，家之誤。

translations.literal: Jia is an error for jia (family/clan).
translations.idiomatic: The character jia is a mistake for jia, meaning "clan."

sentences.zh: 番人稱謂如德格則曰「德格家」，孔撒則曰「孔撒家」。

translations.literal: The fan address Dege as "Degejia" and Kongsa as "Kongsajia."
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen address Dege as "Degejia" and Kongsa as "Kongsajia."

sentences.zh: 布者，番人男子之稱。

translations.literal: Bu is the title for fan men.
translations.idiomatic: Bu is the title used for tribal men.

sentences.zh: 印以「綽斯甲布」為名，誤矣。

translations.literal: To name the seal "Chuosijiabu" is an error.
translations.idiomatic: Naming the seal "Chuosijiabu" was a mistake.

sentences.zh: 始祖資立，康熙三十九年，歸附。

translations.literal: Founding ancestor Zili; in the 39th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor Zili submitted allegiance in the 39th year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，頒給安撫司印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 41st year, the seal and patent documents of Pacification Commissioner were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the 41st year the Pacification Commissioner seal and patent documents were issued.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，出師金川，賞二品頂戴花翎。

translations.literal: In the 37th year of Qianlong, on the expedition to Jinchuan, rewarded with a second-rank cap ornament and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 37th year of Qianlong, on the Jinchuan campaign, he was rewarded with a second-rank cap ornament and peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，頒給宣撫司印信號紙，隨將舊印呈繳。

translations.literal: In the 41st year, the seal and patent documents of Pacification Commissioner were issued, and the old seal was surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the 41st year he received the Pacification Commissioner seal and patent documents and surrendered the old seal.

sentences.zh: 原系阜和協所轄。

translations.literal: Originally under the jurisdiction of the Fuhe Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally fallen under the Fuhe Brigade.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十一年，改隸懋功協管轄。

translations.literal: In the 51st year of Qianlong, jurisdiction was transferred to the Maogong Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In the 51st year of Qianlong its jurisdiction was transferred to the Maogong Brigade.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 以上懋功廳懋功協屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Maogong Brigade of Maogong Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Maogong Brigade of Maogong Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 河東長官司，其先自元迄明，世襲建昌宣慰司。

translations.literal: Hedong native prefect; their forebears from Yuan through Ming hereditarily held the Jianchang Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Hedong had hereditarily held the Jianchang Pacification Commissioner from Yuan through Ming times.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，安泰寧歸附，呈繳明印。

translations.literal: In the 16th year of Shunzhi, An Taining submitted allegiance and surrendered the Ming seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the 16th year of Shunzhi An Taining submitted allegiance and surrendered the Ming seal.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，改授長官司。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Yongzheng, reappointed as native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Yongzheng he was reappointed native prefect.

sentences.zh: 管有大石頭、長村、繼事田三土百戶，利扼、上芍果、阿史、紐姑、上沈渣、下芍果、上熱水、小涼山、慕西、又利呃、阿史、者加十二土目。

translations.literal: It governed three native centurions of Dashitou, Changcun, and Jishitian, and twelve native headmen of Lie'e, Shangshaoguo, A'shi, Niugu, Shangshenzha, Xiashaoguo, Shangreshui, Xiaoliangshan, Muxi, Youlie'e, A'shi, and Zhejia.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised the native centurions of Dashitou, Changcun, and Jishitian, and twelve native headmen including Lie'e, Shangshaoguo, A'shi, Niugu, Shangshenzha, Xiashaoguo, Shangreshui, Xiaoliangshan, Muxi, Youlie'e, A'shi, and Zhejia.

sentences.zh: 阿都正長官司，其先結固，順治六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Adu Chief native prefect; their forebear Jiegu, in the 6th year of Shunzhi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief native prefect of Adu descended from Jiegu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Shunzhi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十九年，土司慕枝為招撫案內，授阿都宣撫司，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 49th year of Kangxi, the native chieftain Muzhi, within the pacification case, was granted Adu Pacification Commissioner and issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 49th year of Kangxi the native chieftain Muzhi, as part of a pacification settlement, was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Adu and issued seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，改土歸流。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Yongzheng, converted from native rule to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Yongzheng the office was abolished in the gaituguiliu conversion to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 是年，涼山野夷不法，土司聚姑擒獻凶首，復授阿都正長官司。

translations.literal: That year, the wild tribes of Liangshan acted unlawfully; the native chieftain Jugu captured and presented the ringleader and was reappointed Adu Chief native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when the wild tribes of Liangshan rebelled, the native chieftain Jugu captured and delivered the ringleader and was reappointed Chief native prefect of Adu.

sentences.zh: 管有歪歪溪、咱古、喬山南、大河西四土目。

translations.literal: It governed four native headmen of Waiwaixi, Zagu, Qiaoshannan, and Dahexi.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised four native headmen: Waiwaixi, Zagu, Qiaoshannan, and Dahexi.

sentences.zh: 副長官司，雍正六年，剿撫涼山夷眾，歸附有功，授阿都副長官司。

translations.literal: Deputy native prefect; in the 6th year of Yongzheng, for merit in suppressing and pacifying the tribes of Liangshan and submitting allegiance, granted Adu Deputy native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The Deputy native prefect: in the 6th year of Yongzheng, for distinguished service in suppressing and pacifying the tribes of Liangshan, he received appointment as Deputy native prefect of Adu.

sentences.zh: 管有小涼山馬希、大梁山拖覺、阿乃、又阿史、結呃、派乃、者膩、那科、那俄、哈乃過、又阿驢十一土目。

translations.literal: It governed eleven native headmen of Xiaoliangshan Maxi, Daliangshan Tuojue, Anai, You A'shi, Jie'e, Painai, Zheni, Nake, Na'e, Hanai Guo, and You A'lu.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised eleven native headmen including Xiaoliangshan Maxi, Daliangshan Tuojue, Anai, A'shi, Jie'e, Painai, Zheni, Nake, Na'e, Hanai Guo, and A'lu.

sentences.zh: 沙罵宣撫司，其先安韋威，康熙四十九年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Shama Pacification Commissioner; their forebear An Weiwei, in the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Shama descended from An Weiwei, who submitted allegiance in the 49th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 管有那多、扼烏、咱烈山、撒凹溝、結覺五土目。

translations.literal: It governed five native headmen of Naduo, E'wu, Zalieshan, Sa'aogou, and Jiejue.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised five native headmen: Naduo, E'wu, Zalieshan, Sa'aogou, and Jiejue.

sentences.zh: 以上西昌縣中營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Middle Battalion of Xichang County.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Middle Battalion of Xichang County.

sentences.zh: 昌州長官司，其先盧尼古，明洪武九年，調守德昌、昌州，康熙四十九年，歸附，承襲。

translations.literal: Changzhou native prefect; their forebear Luni'gu, in the 9th year of Hongwu of Ming, was transferred to guard Dechang and Changzhou; in the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Changzhou descended from Luni'gu, who in the 9th year of Hongwu was posted to guard Dechang and Changzhou; in the 49th year of Kangxi he submitted allegiance and inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 普濟州長官司，其先吉三嘉，明洪武七年，授普濟州土知州。

translations.literal: Pujizhou native prefect; their forebear Jisanjia, in the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, was granted native prefect of Pujizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Pujizhou descended from Jisanjia, who in the 7th year of Hongwu received appointment as native prefect of Pujizhou.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十九年，歸附，承襲，改長官司。

translations.literal: In the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance, inherited the office, and was changed to native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the 49th year of Kangxi he submitted allegiance, inherited the office, and was redesignated native prefect.

sentences.zh: 威龍州長官司，其先張起朝，明洪武七年，授職。

translations.literal: Weilongzhou native prefect; their forebear Zhang Qichao, in the 7th year of Hongwu of Ming, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Weilongzhou descended from Zhang Qichao, who received appointment in the 7th year of Hongwu.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，歸附，世襲。

translations.literal: In the 16th year of Shunzhi, submitted allegiance and held the office hereditarily.
translations.idiomatic: In the 16th year of Shunzhi he submitted allegiance and held the office by hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 以上西昌縣左營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Left Battalion of Xichang County.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Left Battalion of Xichang County.

sentences.zh: 河西宣慰司，其先安吉茂，康熙五十一年，歸附。

translations.literal: Hexi Pacification Commissioner; their forebear An Jimao, in the 51st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Hexi descended from An Jimao, who submitted allegiance in the 51st year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，吉茂歿，無子，嶺氏撫伊兄越巂土司嶺安泰之子為子，更名安祥茂。

translations.literal: In the 57th year, Jimao died without sons; the Ling clan adopted the son of Yuexi native chieftain Ling Antai, his elder brother's child, and renamed him An Xiangmao.
translations.idiomatic: In the 57th year Jimao died without heirs; the Ling clan adopted the son of Yuexi native chieftain Ling Antai, a child of his elder brother, and renamed him An Xiangmao.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，改土歸流，換給土千總職銜，世襲。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Yongzheng, converted from native rule to regular administration; reissued with the title of native company commander, held hereditarily.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Yongzheng the office was converted to direct rule and reissued as a hereditary native company commander.

sentences.zh: 管有囉慕、芍果、咱堡、沙溝四土目。

translations.literal: It governed four native headmen of Luomu, Shaoguo, Zanbao, and Shagou.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised four native headmen: Luomu, Shaoguo, Zanbao, and Shagou.

sentences.zh: 以上西昌縣右營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Right Battalion of Xichang County.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Right Battalion of Xichang County.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 工部宣撫司，其先嶺安盤，康熙四十三年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Gongbu Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Ling Anpan, in the 43rd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Gongbu descended from Ling Anpan, who submitted allegiance in the 43rd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，土司嶺承恩助官軍擒石達開有功，賞二品銜。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Tongzhi, the native chieftain Ling Chengen aided the government army in capturing Shi Dakai with merit and was rewarded with a second-rank title.
translations.idiomatic: In the 2nd year of Tongzhi the native chieftain Ling Chengen aided the government forces in capturing Shi Dakai and was rewarded with a second-rank title.

sentences.zh: 管有膩乃、阿谷、蘇呷、咱戶、慕虐、阿蘇、濫田壩、普雄、黑保、大疏山十土目。

translations.literal: It governed ten native headmen of Ninai, Agu, Suxia, Zanhu, Munue, Asu, Lantianba, Puxiong, Heibao, and Dashushan.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised ten native headmen: Ninai, Agu, Suxia, Zanhu, Munue, Asu, Lantianba, Puxiong, Heibao, and Dashushan.

sentences.zh: 以上越巂廳越巂營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Yuexi Garrison of Yuexi Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Yuexi Garrison of Yuexi Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 暖帶密土千戶，其先嶺安泰，康熙四十九年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Nuandaimi native chiliarch; their forebear Ling Antai, in the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Nuandaimi descended from Ling Antai, who submitted allegiance in the 49th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 管有上官、六革、瓜倮、糾米、布布、阿多六磨、磨卡為呷、西糾七鄉總。

translations.literal: It governed seven native districts in total: Shangguan, Liuge, Gualuo, Jiumi, Bubu, Aduoliumo, Mokaweijia, and Xijiu.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised seven native districts in all: Shangguan, Liuge, Gualuo, Jiumi, Bubu, Aduoliumo, Mokaweijia, and Xijiu.

sentences.zh: 暖帶田壩土千戶，其先部則，唐熙四十四年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Nuandaitianba native chiliarch; their forebear Buze, in the 44th year of Tangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Nuandaitianba descended from Buze, who submitted allegiance in the 44th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 松林地土千戶，其先王德洽，康熙四十九年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Songlindi native chiliarch; their forebear Wang Deqia, in the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Songlindi descended from Wang Deqia, who submitted allegiance in the 49th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 管有老鴉漩、白石村、六翁、野豬塘、前後山、料林坪六土百戶。

translations.literal: It governed six native centurions of Laoyaxuan, Baishicun, Liuweng, Yezhutang, Qianhoushan, and Liaolinping.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised six native centurions: Laoyaxuan, Baishicun, Liuweng, Yezhutang, Qianhoushan, and Liaolinping.

sentences.zh: 以上越巂廳甯越營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Ningyue Garrison of Yuexi Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Ningyue Garrison of Yuexi Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 木里安撫司，其先六藏塗都，雍正七年，歸附。

translations.literal: Muli Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Liuzang Tudu, in the 7th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Muli descended from Liuzang Tudu, who submitted allegiance in the 7th year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 瓜別安撫司，係麼夷人。

translations.literal: Guabie Pacification Commissioner; of Mo Yi people.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Guabie was of Mo Yi stock.

sentences.zh: 其先玉珠迫，康熙四十九年，歸附。

translations.literal: Their forebear Yuzhupo, in the 49th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Its forebear Yuzhupo submitted allegiance in the 49th year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 馬喇副長官司，係夷人。

translations.literal: Mala Deputy native prefect; of Yi people.
translations.idiomatic: The Deputy native prefect of Mala was of Yi stock.

sentences.zh: 其先阿世忠，康熙十九年，歸附，頒給號紙。

translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the founding ancestor Akewangjia'er served with distinction in the campaign against Ming Yuzhen.

translations.literal: In the 36th year of Qianlong, Jiamushen Deqin followed the expedition against Jinchuan with merit and was rewarded with the title "Jiamubotunba," together with a second-rank cap ornament and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 36th year of Qianlong Jiamushen Deqin served with distinction on the Jinchuan campaign and was rewarded with the title Jiamubotunba, a second-rank cap ornament, and the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，甲木參諾爾布隨征廓爾喀，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the 56th year, Jiamushen Nuo'erbu followed the expedition against Gurkha and was rewarded with the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the 56th year Jiamushen Nuo'erbu served on the Gurkha campaign and was rewarded with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十四年，甲木參沙加領班進京恭祝萬壽，賞花翎，世襲，住牧打箭爐城。

translations.literal: In the 14th year of Jiaqing, Jiamushen Shajia led a delegation to the capital to offer birthday congratulations, was rewarded with the peacock feather, held the office hereditarily, and pastured at Dajianlu city.
translations.idiomatic: In the 14th year of Jiaqing Jiamushen Shajia led a delegation to the capital for the imperial birthday and received the peacock feather; the office was hereditary and he pastured at Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年七月，趙爾豐奏改打箭爐為康定府，設河口縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the 34th year of Guangxu, Zhao Erfeng memorialized to change Dajianlu to Kangding Prefecture and establish Hekou County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Guangxu 34 Zhao Erfeng memorialized to convert Dajianlu into Kangding Prefecture and establish Hekou County.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，土司甲木參瓊珀繳印，其地悉歸流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, the native chieftain Jiamushen Qiongpo surrendered his seal and all the territory was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong the native chieftain Jiamushen Qiongpo surrendered his seal and the entire domain was converted to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 原管有咱哩木千戶，木噶、瓦七、俄洛、白桑、惡熱、下八義、少誤石、作蘇策、八哩籠、上渡噶喇住索、中渡啞出卡、他咳、索窩籠、惡拉、樂壤、扒桑、木轤、格窪卡、呷那工弄、吉增卡桑阿籠、沙卡、上八義、拉里、八烏籠、姆硃、上渣壩惡疊、上渣壩卓泥、中渣壩熱錯、中渣壩沱、下渣壩業窪石、下渣壩莫藏石、魯密東谷、魯密普工碟、魯密郭宗、魯密結藏、魯密祖卜柏哈、魯密初把、魯密昌拉、魯密堅正、魯密達媽、魯密格桑、魯密本滾、長結杵尖、長結松歸、魯密白隅、魯密梭布、魯密達則、魯密卓籠四十八土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed the Zalimu chiliarch and forty-eight native centurions: Muga, Waqi, Eluo, Baisang, Ere, Lower Bayi, Shaowushi, Zuosuce, Balilong, Upper Dugala Zhuisuo, Middle Duyachuka, Takai, Suowolong, Ela, Lerang, Basang, Mulu, Gewaka, Xianagongnong, Jizeng Kasang'along, Shaka, Upper Bayi, Lali, Bawulong, Muzhu, Upper Zhaba Edie, Upper Zhaba Zhuoni, Middle Zhaba Recuo, Middle Zhaba Tuo, Lower Zhaba Yewashi, Lower Zhaba Mocangshi, Lumi Donggu, Lumi Pugongdie, Lumi Guozong, Lumi Jiecang, Lumi Zububaiha, Lumi Chuba, Lumi Changla, Lumi Jianzheng, Lumi Dama, Lumi Gesang, Lumi Bengun, Changjie Chujian, Changjie Songgui, Lumi Baiyu, Lumi Suobu, Lumi Daze, and Lumi Zhuolong.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed the Zalimu chiliarch and forty-eight native centurions, including Muga, Waqi, Eluo, Baisang, Ere, Lower Bayi, Shaowushi, Zuosuce, Balilong, Upper Dugala Zhuisuo, Middle Duyachuka, Takai, Suowolong, Ela, Lerang, Basang, Mulu, Gewaka, Xianagongnong, Jizeng Kasang'along, Shaka, Upper Bayi, Lali, Bawulong, Muzhu, the Upper, Middle, and Lower Zhaba districts, and the Lumi and Changjie sub-districts.

sentences.zh: 革伯咱安撫司，其先魏珠布策淩，康熙三十九年，歸附，授職，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: Gebozan Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Weizhubuceling, in the 39th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance, received appointment, and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Gebozan descended from Weizhubuceling, who submitted allegiance in the 39th year of Kangxi, received appointment, and was granted seal and patent documents.

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 巴底宣慰司，其先綽布木淩，康熙四十一年，歸附，授巴底安撫司。

translations.literal: Badi Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Chuobumuling, in the 41st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and was granted Pacification Commissioner of Badi.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Badi descended from Chuobumuling, who submitted allegiance in the 41st year of Kangxi and received appointment as Pacification Commissioner of Badi.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 巴旺宣慰司，與巴底土司同世系，分駐巴旺，共管地方土民。

translations.literal: Bawang Pacification Commissioner; of the same lineage as the Badi native chieftain, separately stationed at Bawang, jointly governing the local native people.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Bawang shared the Badi line, was stationed separately at Bawang, and jointly governed the local tribes.

translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.
