translations.literal: La Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Aweita'er, in the 40th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of La descended from Aweita'er, who submitted allegiance in the 40th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 霍耳竹窩安撫司，即倬倭。

translations.literal: Huo'er Zhuowo Pacification Commissioner; that is, Zhuowai.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Huo'er Zhuowo was Zhuowai.

sentences.zh: 其先索諾木袞卜，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Their forebear Suonuomugunbu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Its forebear Suonuomugunbu submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 原管有瓦述寫達、瓦述更平東撒兩土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed two native centurions of Washu Xieda and Washu Gengping Dongsan.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed the native centurions of Washu Xieda and Washu Gengping Dongsan.

sentences.zh: 霍耳章谷安撫司，其先羅卜策旺，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Zhanggu Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Luobucewang, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Huo'er Zhanggu descended from Luobucewang, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，瞻對欲奪其地，鹿傳霖派兵滅瞻對，同倬倭一併改流。

translations.literal: In the 20th year of Guangxu, Drayak sought to seize its territory; Lu Chuanlin dispatched troops to destroy Drayak and converted it together with Zhuowai to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20, when Drayak sought to seize its territory, Lu Chuanlin sent troops to destroy Drayak and converted both it and Zhuowai to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 後發還，而章谷無人承領，改為爐霍屯。

translations.literal: Later it was returned, but Zhanggu had no one to inherit the office and was changed to the Luhuo garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The territory was later restored, but with no heir at Zhanggu it was converted into the Luhuo garrison.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 納林沖長官司，其先諾爾布，雍正六年，歸附，授職，與章谷土司一家。

translations.literal: Nalinchong native prefect; their forebear Nuo'erbu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance, received appointment, and was of the same family as the Zhanggu native chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Nalinchong descended from Nuo'erbu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and belonged to the same family as the Zhanggu chieftain.

sentences.zh: 瓦述色他長官司，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Washu Seta native prefect; in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Seta submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓦述更平長官司，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Washu Gengping native prefect; in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Gengping submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓦述餘科長官司，其先沙克嘉諾爾布，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Washu Yuke native prefect; their forebear Shakejianuo'erbu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Yuke descended from Shakejianuo'erbu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 霍耳孔撒安撫司，其先麻蘇爾特親，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Kongsa Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Masu'erteqin, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Huo'er Kongsa descended from Masu'erteqin, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 管有科則、圖根滿碟兩土百戶。

translations.literal: It governed two native centurions of Keze and Tugen Mandie.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised the native centurions of Keze and Tugen Mandie.

sentences.zh: 霍耳甘孜麻書安撫司，其先那木卡索諾木，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Ganzi Mashu Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Namukasuonuomu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Huo'er Ganzi Mashu descended from Namukasuonuomu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 原管有革賚、朿暑、又朿暑三土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed three native centurions of Gela, Shushu, and You Shushu.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed the native centurions of Gela, Shushu, and You Shushu.

sentences.zh: 德爾格忒宣慰司，其先丹巴策淩。

translations.literal: Dege Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Danbuceling.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Dege descended from Danbuceling.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，歸附，授德爾格忒安撫司。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and was granted Pacification Commissioner of Dege.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Yongzheng he submitted allegiance and received appointment as Pacification Commissioner of Dege.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, changed to Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the 11th year the office was elevated to Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諸土司部落，以德格為最大，東連瞻對，西連察木多，南連巴塘，北連西寧。

translations.literal: Among the native chieftain tribes, Dege was the largest, connecting east with Drayak, west with Qamdo, south with Batang, and north with Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Of all the chieftain domains, Dege was the largest, bordering Drayak to the east, Qamdo to the west, Batang to the south, and Xining to the north.

sentences.zh: 番人以其地大，有「天德格，地德格」之稱。

translations.literal: The fan, because its territory was vast, had the saying "Heavenly Dege, Earthly Dege."
translations.idiomatic: Because of its vast territory, the tribesmen called it "Heavenly Dege, Earthly Dege."

sentences.zh: 鹿傳霖派兵攻瞻對時，訪得德格土司羅追彭錯妻玉米者登仁甲生子名多吉僧格，又與頭人通，生子名降白仁青，以是與夫反目。

translations.literal: When Lu Chuanlin dispatched troops to attack Drayak, it was learned that the wife of Dege native chieftain Luozhui Pengcuo, Yumizhe Dengrenjia, bore a son named Duojisen'ge, and also consorted with a headman and bore a son named Jiangbairinqing; for this she turned against her husband.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Chuanlin attacked Drayak, it emerged that the Dege chieftain Luozhui Pengcuo's wife Yumizhe Dengrenjia had borne him a son, Duojisen'ge, but had also taken a headman as lover and borne Jiangbairinqing, turning her against her husband.

sentences.zh: 玉米者登仁甲本藏女，於瞻對藏官有姻誼，藏官助之抗其夫，故各攜其子分居焉。

translations.literal: Yumizhe Dengrenjia was originally a Tibetan woman and had affinal ties with the Tibetan officials of Drayak; the Tibetan officials aided her in resisting her husband, so each took their son and lived separately.
translations.idiomatic: Yumizhe Dengrenjia was a Tibetan woman with kin ties to Drayak's Tibetan officials, who backed her against her husband; each party then withdrew with its son to separate domains.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，官軍計誘羅追彭錯，言為之逐其婦及降白仁青，因入德格。

translations.literal: In the 20th year of Guangxu, the government army devised a ruse to lure Luozhui Pengcuo, saying they would drive out his wife and Jiangbairinqing for him, and thus entered Dege.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 the government forces lured Luozhui Pengcuo with a promise to expel his wife and Jiangbairinqing, and thus entered Dege.

sentences.zh: 洎傳霖被劾，罷改流議。

translations.literal: When Chuanlin was impeached, the plan for conversion to regular administration was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: When Chuanlin was impeached, the conversion plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 土司夫婦旋病故，傳霖奏遣其二子回籍，多吉僧格暫管地方。

translations.literal: The native chieftain and his wife soon died of illness; Chuanlin memorialized to send their two sons back to their native place, and Duojisen'ge temporarily managed the territory.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftain and his wife soon died; Chuanlin memorialized to send their two sons home, leaving Duojisen'ge to administer the domain.

sentences.zh: 降白仁青已為僧，繼而招致多人爭職，多吉僧格奔藏。

translations.literal: Jiangbairinqing had already become a monk, but then drew many to contest the office; Duojisen'ge fled to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangbairinqing had taken monastic vows, but soon rallied rivals for the chieftainship and drove Duojisen'ge to flee into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 德格頭人百姓以降白仁青非土司子，且殘暴，迎多吉僧格歸。

translations.literal: The headmen and common people of Dege, because Jiangbairinqing was not the chieftain's son and was cruel, welcomed Duojisen'ge back.
translations.idiomatic: Dege's headmen and people, rejecting Jiangbairinqing as no true heir and abhorring his cruelty, welcomed Duojisen'ge back.

sentences.zh: 降白仁青避位數年，頭人正巴阿登等嗾其再起爭職，並誘占多吉僧格之妾。

translations.literal: Jiangbairinqing withdrew from office for several years; the headman Zhengba Adeng and others incited him to contest the office again and seduced and seized Duojisen'ge's concubine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangbairinqing had withdrawn for years when headman Zhengba Adeng and others incited him to reclaim the chieftainship and seduced Duojisen'ge's concubine.

sentences.zh: 多吉僧格夫婦復奔藏，控於駐藏大臣有泰、張廕棠。

translations.literal: Duojisen'ge and his wife again fled to Tibet and lodged complaints with the Resident Commissioner in Tibet, Youtai and Zhang Yintang.
translations.idiomatic: Duojisen'ge and his wife fled again to Tibet and appealed to Resident Commissioners Youtai and Zhang Yintang.

sentences.zh: 既而德格百姓復迎之歸，錮降白仁青。

translations.literal: Soon after, the people of Dege again welcomed them back and imprisoned Jiangbairinqing.
translations.idiomatic: The Dege people soon welcomed them back and imprisoned Jiangbairinqing.

sentences.zh: 降白仁青脫出，聚黨作亂，人民多被殺戮，多吉僧格遣人至打箭爐告急。

translations.literal: Jiangbairinqing escaped, gathered followers and rebelled, many people were slaughtered, and Duojisen'ge sent men to Dajianlu to report the emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangbairinqing broke free, raised a rebellion, and slaughtered many people; Duojisen'ge sent messengers to Dajianlu for help.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年四月，趙爾豐率兵討之，降白仁青敗逃入藏。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the 1st year of Xuantong, Zhao Erfeng led troops to suppress him; Jiangbairinqing was defeated and fled into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Xuantong 1 Zhao Erfeng marched against him; Jiangbairinqing was defeated and fled into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 多吉僧格夫婦請改流，爾豐不欲利其危亂，許以復職。

translations.literal: Duojisen'ge and his wife requested conversion to regular administration; Erfeng did not wish to profit from their peril and disorder and permitted them to resume office.
translations.idiomatic: Duojisen'ge and his wife petitioned for conversion to direct rule, but Erfeng, unwilling to exploit their crisis, allowed them to resume office.

sentences.zh: 多吉僧格泣曰：「德格地廣人稀，窺伺者眾，終恐不自保，原招漢人開墾，使地辟民聚，乃可圖存。

translations.literal: Duojisen'ge wept and said: "Dege's territory is vast and its people sparse; many watch to seize it—I fear we cannot long preserve ourselves. I wish to invite Han settlers to open the land so the domain may be settled and populated, and only then can we hope to endure.
translations.idiomatic: Duojisen'ge wept and said, "Dege is vast and sparsely peopled, with many covetous neighbors—we cannot long survive alone. I wish to bring in Han settlers to open the land, populate the domain, and only then preserve ourselves.

sentences.zh: 」意極堅決。

translations.literal: " His intent was extremely firm.
translations.idiomatic: " His resolve was absolute.

sentences.zh: 爾豐奏分其地為五區：中區德化州，南區白玉州，北區登科府，極北一區即石渠歸，西區則同普縣，而邊北道駐登科焉。

translations.literal: Erfeng memorialized to divide the territory into five districts: the central district as Dehua Prefecture, the southern district as Baiyu Prefecture, the northern district as Dengke Prefecture, the far northern district as Shiqu Gui, the western district as Tongpu County, with the Northern Frontier Circuit stationed at Dengke.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng memorialized to divide the domain into five districts: Dehua in the center, Baiyu in the south, Dengke in the north, Shiqu Gui in the far north, and Tongpu in the west, with the Northern Frontier Circuit based at Dengke.

sentences.zh: 多吉僧格納其財產於官，徙家巴塘，復以奏給養贍銀及其妻姒郎錯莫首飾捐助巴塘學費。

translations.literal: Duojisen'ge surrendered his property to the government, moved his household to Batang, and further donated the maintenance silver granted by memorial and his wife Silangcuomo's jewelry to Batang school funds.
translations.idiomatic: Duojisen'ge surrendered his property to the state, moved his household to Batang, and donated his maintenance stipend and his wife Silangcuomo's jewelry to Batang school funds.

sentences.zh: 爾豐奏賞頭品頂戴，並予其妻建坊。

translations.literal: Erfeng memorialized to reward him with a first-rank cap ornament and to erect an honor arch for his wife.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng memorialized to grant him a first-rank cap ornament and erect an honor arch for his wife.

sentences.zh: 原管有四上革賚、雜竹嗎竹卡、籠壩，六土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed six native centurions: Four Upper Gela, Zazhu Mazhuka, and Longba.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed six native centurions: Four Upper Gela, Zazhu Mazhuka, and Longba.

sentences.zh: 霍耳白利長官司，其先隆溥特查什，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Baili native prefect; their forebear Longputechashi, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Huo'er Baili descended from Longputechashi, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 霍耳咱安撫司，其先阿克旺錯爾恥木，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Za Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Akewangcuo'erchimu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Huo'er Za descended from Akewangcuo'erchimu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 管有兩下革賚土百戶。

translations.literal: It governed the Two Lower Gela native centurion.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised the Two Lower Gela native centurion.

sentences.zh: 霍耳東科長官司，其先達罕格努，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Huo'er Dongke native prefect; their forebear Dahan Genu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Huo'er Dongke descended from Dahan Genu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 春科安撫司，其先袞卜旺劄爾，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Chunke Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Gunbu Wangzha'er, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Chunke descended from Gunbu Wangzha'er, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 副土司與安撫司一家，同時歸附授職。

translations.literal: The deputy native chieftain was of the same family as the Pacification Commissioner and at the same time submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy chieftain belonged to the same family as the Pacification Commissioner and received appointment when they submitted together.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 高日長官司，其先自印布，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Gaori native prefect; their forebear Ziyinbu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Gaori descended from Ziyinbu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 蒙葛結長官司，其先達木袞布，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Menggejie native prefect; their forebear Damugunbu, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Menggejie descended from Damugunbu, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 林蔥安撫司，其先袞卜林親，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Lincong Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Gunbulinqin, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Lincong descended from Gunbulinqin, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 上納奪安撫司，其先索諾木旺劄爾，雍正六年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Shangnaduo Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Suonuomuwangzha'er, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Shangnaduo descended from Suonuomuwangzha'er, who submitted allegiance in the 6th year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改流。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year of Xuantong, converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the 3rd year of Xuantong it was converted to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 原管有上納奪土千戶，上納奪黎窩、上納奪、納奪黎窩三土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed the Shangnaduo native chiliarch and three native centurions of Shangnaduo Liwo, Shangnaduo, and Naduo Liwo.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed the Shangnaduo native chiliarch and the native centurions of Shangnaduo Liwo, Shangnaduo, and Naduo Liwo.

sentences.zh: 瞻對有上、中、下三名。

translations.literal: Drayak had three names: Upper, Middle, and Lower.
translations.idiomatic: Drayak was divided into Upper, Middle, and Lower.

sentences.zh: 上瞻對茹長官司、下瞻對安撫司，均雍正六年歸附授職；

translations.literal: The Upper Drayak Ru native prefect and Lower Drayak Pacification Commissioner both in the 6th year of Yongzheng submitted allegiance and received appointment;
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Upper Drayak Ru and the Pacification Commissioner of Lower Drayak both submitted and received appointment in the 6th year of Yongzheng;

sentences.zh: 中瞻對長官司，乾隆十年授職。

translations.literal: the Middle Drayak native prefect received appointment in the 10th year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: the native prefect of Middle Drayak received appointment in the 10th year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 距打箭爐七日程。

translations.literal: Seven days' march from Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seven days' march from Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 東連明正，南接裏塘，西北與德格土司毗連。

translations.literal: East it connected with Mingzheng, south it adjoined Litang, northwest it bordered the Dege native chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered Mingzheng to the east, Litang to the south, and the Dege chieftain to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 縱橫數百里，為鴉龍江之上游。

translations.literal: Several hundred li in length and breadth, it was the upper reaches of the Yalong River.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred li across, it formed the upper reaches of the Yalong River.

sentences.zh: 同治初，川、藏會攻瞻對，川軍未至，藏兵先克瞻對，派民官一、僧官一，率兵駐守，由達賴喇嘛及商上選任咨請駐藏大臣奏明，每三年替換。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongzhi, Sichuan and Tibet jointly attacked Drayak; before the Sichuan army arrived, Tibetan troops first captured Drayak and dispatched one civil official and one monastic official to garrison with troops, selected and appointed through consultation by the Dalai Lama and the Kashag and memorialized by the Resident Commissioner in Tibet, replaced every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tongzhi, Sichuan and Tibet jointly attacked Drayak; Tibetan troops took it before the Sichuan column arrived and installed one civil and one monastic official with a garrison, chosen by the Dalai Lama and Kashag and confirmed by the Resident Commissioner, rotated every three years.

sentences.zh: 藏官恣行暴政，誅求無厭，瞻對民不堪命，屢起抗官，疆吏率加壓服，仍令屬藏。

translations.literal: The Tibetan officials tyrannically practiced brutal governance and extorted without limit; the people of Drayak could not bear it, repeatedly rose against the officials, and frontier officials generally suppressed them and still left them under Tibetan jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan officials ruled brutally and extorted without end; the people of Drayak rebelled repeatedly, only to be suppressed by frontier officials and left under Tibetan rule.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，鹿傳霖討平瞻對，議改流，卒為恭壽、文海劾罷。

translations.literal: In the 20th year of Guangxu, Lu Chuanlin suppressed Drayak and proposed conversion to regular administration, but was ultimately impeached and dismissed by Gongshou and Wenhai.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 Lu Chuanlin pacified Drayak and proposed direct rule, but was impeached and dismissed by Gongshou and Wenhai.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，趙爾豐由川赴關外，德格土司百姓沿途控告瞻對藏官侵奪土地，四出虐民，並曆訴中朝兩次將瞻對歸藏時，藏官追究內附者一一孥戮之慘。

translations.literal: In the 34th year, Zhao Erfeng traveled from Sichuan to the frontier; the people of the Dege native chieftain along the way complained that Drayak's Tibetan officials seized land, abused people everywhere, and recounted the horror of how, when the court twice returned Drayak to Tibet, the Tibetan officials hunted down those who had submitted and slaughtered them and their families.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34, as Zhao Erfeng traveled from Sichuan to the frontier, Dege people petitioned all along the route against Drayak's Tibetan officials for seizing land and brutalizing the populace, recounting how on two occasions when Drayak was returned to Tibet the officials had hunted down submitters and slaughtered their families.

sentences.zh: 藏官不自安，陰欲添兵攻爾豐，爾豐令傅嵩矞率兵赴昌泰扼之。

translations.literal: The Tibetan officials felt insecure and secretly wished to add troops to attack Erfeng; Erfeng ordered Fu Songyu to lead troops to Changtai to block them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan officials, uneasy, secretly planned to reinforce and attack Erfeng; he ordered Fu Songyu to Changtai to block them.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年春，爾豐建議收瞻對，樞府令駐藏大臣聯豫、溫宗堯與藏人議贖未成，樞臣恐牽動外交，持不斷。

translations.literal: In the spring of the 1st year of Xuantong, Erfeng proposed recovering Drayak; the Grand Council ordered Resident Commissioner Lianyu and Wen Zongyao to negotiate redemption with the Tibetans without success; grand councillors feared provoking foreign relations and remained undecided.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Xuantong 1 Erfeng proposed recovering Drayak; the Grand Council ordered Lianyu and Wen Zongyao to negotiate redemption with Tibet without success, and the court, fearing diplomatic complications, could not decide.

sentences.zh: 於是爾豐與嵩矞議，決以計取之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Erfeng and Songyu agreed to take it by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng and Songyu then resolved to take it by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，爾豐調任入川，偕嵩矞整兵經瞻對。

translations.literal: In the summer of the 3rd year, Erfeng was transferred back to Sichuan and, together with Songyu, marshaled troops through Drayak.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Xuantong 3, Erfeng was transferred to Sichuan and marched through Drayak with Songyu at the head of his troops.

sentences.zh: 藏官憚軍勢之盛，潛遁去，瞻人歡舞出迎。

translations.literal: The Tibetan officials feared the army's strength and secretly fled; the people of Drayak danced with joy to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan officials, awed by the army's strength, fled in secret, and the people of Drayak danced out to welcome the troops.

sentences.zh: 因收回設治。

translations.literal: Thus it was recovered and regular administration established.
translations.idiomatic: Drayak was recovered and direct administration established.

sentences.zh: 尋爾豐至川奏聞。

translations.literal: Soon after Erfeng reached Sichuan and memorialized the court.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng soon reached Sichuan and memorialized the court.

sentences.zh: 以上打箭爐廳阜和協屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Fuhe Brigade of Dajianlu Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Fuhe Brigade of Dajianlu Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，均頒有印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 里塘宣撫司，其先番目江擺，康熙五十七年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Litang Pacification Commissioner; their forebear the fan headman Jiangbai, in the 57th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Litang descended from the tribal headman Jiangbai, who submitted allegiance in the 57th year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 傳至索諾木根登，因不能約束帳下頭人云甸等，致滋事端，革去土職，以土都司布洛工布拔補。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Suonuomugendeng, who because he could not restrain the headmen under his banner such as Yundian and others, causing disturbances, was removed from native office; the native commander Buluogongbu was selected to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Suonuomugendeng, who was stripped of office for failing to control headmen such as Yundian and causing unrest; the native commander Buluogongbu was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 里塘、巴塘兩土司例於頭人內揀補，與他土司不同。

translations.literal: The two native chieftains of Litang and Batang were by precedent selected and replaced from among headmen, unlike other native chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Litang and Batang chieftains were by precedent chosen from among headmen, unlike other chieftainships.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十二年，希洛工布為竹馬策登等所害，以頭人阿策拔補，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 12th year of Jiaqing, Xiluogongbu was killed by Zhuma Cedeng and others; the headman Ace was selected to replace him and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 12th year of Jiaqing Xiluogongbu was killed by Zhuma Cedeng and others; headman Ace replaced him and received seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 副土司，其先番目康卻江錯，與正土司同時歸附。

translations.literal: Deputy native chieftain; their forebear the fan headman Kangque Jiangcuo, at the same time as the chief chieftain, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy chieftain descended from the tribal headman Kangque Jiangcuo, who submitted together with the chief chieftain.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，授職。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Yongzheng, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Yongzheng he received appointment.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年，土司羅藏策登為正土司頭人云甸等戕害，以頭人阿彩登舟拔補，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 8th year of Jiaqing, the native chieftain Luozang Cedeng was killed by the chief chieftain's headmen Yundian and others; the headman Acai Dengzhou was selected to replace him and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 8th year of Jiaqing chieftain Luozang Cedeng was killed by the chief chieftain's headmen Yundian and others; headman Acai Dengzhou replaced him and received seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 向設守備一、把總一。

translations.literal: There were formerly one garrison commander and one company commander.
translations.idiomatic: The post had one garrison commander and one company commander.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年，川軍討巴塘亂，里塘頭人不支烏拉，糧餉不能轉連，趙爾豐誅頭人，正土司逃往稻壩貢噶嶺，嘯聚土人為亂。

translations.literal: In the 31st year of Guangxu, when the Sichuan army suppressed the Batang rebellion, Litang's headmen could not bear the ulag corvée and grain supplies could not be transported; Zhao Erfeng executed headmen, the chief chieftain fled to Daoba Gonggalin, and gathered native people in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31, as the Sichuan army suppressed the Batang rebellion, Litang headmen could not sustain the ulag corvée and supply lines failed; Zhao Erfeng executed headmen, the chief chieftain fled to Daoba Gonggalin, and rallied tribesmen in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 爾豐移師攻鄉城，分兵先剿稻壩。

translations.literal: Erfeng shifted his army to attack Xiangcheng and detached troops first to suppress Daoba.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng turned to attack Xiangcheng and detached a column first to suppress Daoba.

sentences.zh: 正土司敗逃入藏，稻壩平。

translations.literal: The chief chieftain was defeated and fled into Tibet; Daoba was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The chief chieftain was defeated and fled into Tibet, and Daoba was pacified.

sentences.zh: 先是鄉城喇嘛普中劄娃強悍知兵，誘殺里塘守備李朝富父子。

translations.literal: Earlier the Xiangcheng lama Puzhong Zhawa was fierce and skilled in warfare and lured and killed Litang garrison commander Li Chaofu and his son.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Xiangcheng lama Puzhong Zhawa, a fierce and capable fighter, had lured and killed Litang garrison commander Li Chaofu and his son.

sentences.zh: 鹿傳霖派遊擊施文明討之，為所擒，剝皮實草，懸以為號。

translations.literal: Lu Chuanlin dispatched the battalion commander Shi Wenming to suppress him; he was captured, skinned and stuffed with straw, and hung up as a banner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chuanlin sent battalion commander Shi Wenming against him; he was captured, flayed and stuffed with straw, and hung up as a trophy.

sentences.zh: 三十二年正月，爾豐率兵督攻，大小數十戰，匪退喇嘛寺死守。

translations.literal: In the first month of the 32nd year, Erfeng led troops in direct assault; after several dozen battles large and small, the rebels retreated to the lama temple and held it to the death.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guangxu 32 Erfeng led the assault; after dozens of engagements the rebels withdrew into the lama temple and held it to the death.

sentences.zh: 爾豐圍之數月，斷其水道，普中劄娃自縊，諸番皆降，改里塘為順化縣。

translations.literal: Erfeng besieged it for several months and cut off its water supply; Puzhong Zhawa hanged himself, all the fan submitted, and Litang was changed to Shunhua County.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng besieged the temple for months and cut off its water; Puzhong Zhawa hanged himself, the tribes submitted, and Litang became Shunhua County.

sentences.zh: 三十四年秋，復改里化同知，以鄉城為定鄉縣，稻壩為稻城縣，貢噶嶺設縣丞。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the 34th year, it was again changed to Lihua subprefect; Xiangcheng became Dingxiang County, Daoba became Daocheng County, and Gonggalin was given an assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guangxu 34 the post became the Lihua subprefect; Xiangcheng became Dingxiang County, Daoba Daocheng County, and Gonggalin an assistant magistrate.

sentences.zh: 瓦述毛丫長官司，其先番目索郎羅布，康熙六十一年，歸附。

translations.literal: Washu Maoya native prefect; their forebear the fan headman Suolang Luobu, in the 61st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Maoya descended from the tribal headman Suolang Luobu, who submitted allegiance in the 61st year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，授職。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Yongzheng, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Yongzheng he received appointment.

sentences.zh: 崇喜長官司，其先番目杜納台吉，康熙六十一年，歸附。

translations.literal: Chongxi native prefect; their forebear the fan headman Duna Taiji, in the 61st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Chongxi descended from the tribal headman Duna Taiji, who submitted allegiance in the 61st year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，授職。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Yongzheng, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Yongzheng he received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓦述曲登長官司，其先番目康珠，康熙六十一年，歸附。

translations.literal: Washu Qudeng native prefect; their forebear the fan headman Kangzhu, in the 61st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Qudeng descended from the tribal headman Kangzhu, who submitted allegiance in the 61st year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，授職。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Yongzheng, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Yongzheng he received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓦述啯隴長官司，嘉慶十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Washu Guolong native prefect; in the 12th year of Jiaqing, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Washu Guolong submitted allegiance and received appointment in the 12th year of Jiaqing.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒有印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 瓦述茂丫土百戶，其先番目側冷工，康熙六十一年，歸附。

translations.literal: Washu Maoya native centurion; their forebear the fan headman Celenggong, in the 61st year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Washu Maoya descended from the tribal headman Celenggong, who submitted allegiance in the 61st year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，授職。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Yongzheng, received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Yongzheng he received appointment.

sentences.zh: 瓦述麻里土百戶，嘉慶十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Washu Mali native centurion; in the 12th year of Jiaqing, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Washu Mali submitted allegiance and received appointment in the 12th year of Jiaqing.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒有號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued patent documents.

sentences.zh: 以上里塘糧務屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Litang grain administration.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Litang grain administration.

sentences.zh: 巴塘宣撫司，其先羅布阿旺，康熙五十八年，歸附，授職，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: Batang Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Luobu Awang, in the 58th year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance, received appointment, and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Batang descended from Luobu Awang, who submitted allegiance in the 58th year of Kangxi, received appointment, and was granted seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 副土司同。

translations.literal: The deputy native chieftain likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy chieftain was the same.

sentences.zh: 由四川設糧員一、都司一、千總一，三年更替。

translations.literal: Sichuan established one grain officer, one commander, and one company commander, rotated every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan posted one grain officer, one commander, and one company commander, rotated every three years.

sentences.zh: 其喇嘛寺設堪布一、鐵棒一，為僧官，亦三年另換。

translations.literal: Its lama temple established one khenpo and one disciplinarian as monastic officials, also replaced every three years.
translations.idiomatic: The lama temple had one khenpo and one disciplinarian as monastic officials, also rotated every three years.

sentences.zh: 堪布掌管教務經典，鐵棒管理僧人條規。

translations.literal: The khenpo managed religious affairs and scriptures; the disciplinarian managed monastic rules for monks.
translations.idiomatic: The khenpo oversaw religious affairs and scriptures; the disciplinarian enforced monastic discipline.

sentences.zh: 番人犯罪，土司治之。

translations.literal: When fan committed crimes, the native chieftain judged them.
translations.idiomatic: Lay tribesmen were judged by the native chieftain.

sentences.zh: 番人之喇嘛犯罪，鐵棒治之。

translations.literal: When fan lamas committed crimes, the disciplinarian judged them.
translations.idiomatic: Monks were judged by the disciplinarian.

sentences.zh: 土餉以賦相抵，不足由官補給，年約銀千餘兩。

translations.literal: Native tribute was offset by tax levies; shortfalls were supplemented by the government, about one thousand taels of silver per year.
translations.idiomatic: Native tribute was offset by tax assessments, with shortfalls covered by the government at about one thousand taels of silver per year.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，駐藏幫辦大臣鳳全赴任，道經巴塘，見地土膏腴，即招漢人往墾，築墾場於茨梨隴，委巴塘糧員吳錫珍、都司吳以忠兼理。

translations.literal: In the 30th year of Guangxu, the Assistant Resident Commissioner in Tibet Feng Quan traveled to his post, passed through Batang, saw the land was fertile, immediately recruited Han settlers to open cultivation, built a reclamation field at Cililong, and entrusted Batang grain officer Wu Xizhen and commander Wu Yizhong jointly to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 Assistant Resident Commissioner Feng Quan, passing through Batang on his way to Tibet, saw fertile land and recruited Han settlers, establishing a reclamation colony at Cililong under Batang grain officer Wu Xizhen and commander Wu Yizhong.

sentences.zh: 番人驚沮，土司堪布勸鳳全速入藏，不聽。

translations.literal: The fan were alarmed and dismayed; the native chieftain and khenpo urged Feng Quan to hurry into Tibet, but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen were alarmed; the chieftain and khenpo urged Feng Quan to proceed quickly into Tibet, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，七村溝番民聚眾劫殺墾夫，吳以忠陣亡，鳳全避入正土司寨，與亂民議和。

translations.literal: In the spring of the 31st year, the fan of Qicungou gathered in a mob, robbed and killed settlers; Wu Yizhong died in battle; Feng Quan took refuge in the chief chieftain's stockade and negotiated peace with the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Guangxu 31 tribesmen of Qicungou massacred the settlers; Wu Yizhong was killed in battle; Feng Quan took refuge in the chief chieftain's stockade and negotiated with the rebels.

sentences.zh: 亂民迫鳳全回川，許息事，鳳全信之。

translations.literal: The rebels forced Feng Quan to return to Sichuan, promising to end the trouble; Feng Quan believed them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels forced Feng Quan back toward Sichuan with promises of peace, and he believed them.

sentences.zh: 東行數里，至鸚哥嘴，被殺。

translations.literal: Traveling east several li, at Yinggezui he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: A few li east, at Yinggezui, he was murdered.

sentences.zh: 夏，馬維騏、趙爾豐往討，六月十八日，克巴塘，誅兩土司並堪布喇嘛及首惡數人。

translations.literal: In summer, Ma Weiqi and Zhao Erfeng went to suppress them; on the eighteenth day of the sixth month they captured Batang and executed both native chieftains, the khenpo lama, and several ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Ma Weiqi and Zhao Erfeng marched against them; on the eighteenth of the sixth month they took Batang and executed both chieftains, the khenpo lama, and several ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 爾豐搜剿餘匪，因移師定鄉城。

translations.literal: Erfeng searched out and suppressed remaining rebels and therefore shifted his army to pacify Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng mopped up the remaining rebels and turned his army toward Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 三十二年秋，爾豐會錫良暨雲貴總督丁振鐸具奏改流，設巴安縣。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the 32nd year, Erfeng together with Xi Liang and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ding Zhenduo jointly memorialized for conversion to regular administration and established Ba'an County.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guangxu 32 Erfeng, Xi Liang, and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ding Zhenduo jointly memorialized for direct rule and established Ba'an County.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，改巴安府，分設鹽井縣三壩通判，並設康安道，駐巴塘。

translations.literal: In the 34th year, changed to Ba'an Prefecture, separately established Yanjing County and the Sanba subprefect, and established the Kang'an Circuit stationed at Batang.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 it became Ba'an Prefecture, with Yanjing County and the Sanba subprefect established separately and the Kang'an Circuit based at Batang.

sentences.zh: 原管有上臨卡石、下臨卡石、岡、桑隆、上阿蘇、下阿蘇、郭布等七土百戶。

translations.literal: Originally it governed seven native centurions: Upper Linkashi, Lower Linkashi, Gang, Sanglong, Upper Asu, Lower Asu, and Guobu.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed seven native centurions: Upper Linkashi, Lower Linkashi, Gang, Sanglong, Upper Asu, Lower Asu, and Guobu.

sentences.zh: 巴塘糧務屬。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Batang grain administration.
translations.idiomatic: It fell under the Batang grain administration.

sentences.zh: 嶺夷十二地夷人頭目，嘉慶十三年，歸附，給有頭目牌。

translations.literal: The headmen of the Yi people in the twelve districts of Lingyi, in the 13th year of Jiaqing, submitted allegiance and were granted headman plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi headmen of the twelve Lingyi districts submitted allegiance in the 13th year of Jiaqing and received headman plaques.

sentences.zh: 十六年，改流，更姓住牧。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, converted to regular administration; surnames were changed and they settled to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the 16th year they were converted to direct rule, assigned surnames, and settled to pasture.

sentences.zh: 豹嶺岡姓高，趕山坪姓澤，阿葉坪姓惠，牛跌蠻姓周，芭蕉溝姓華，龍竹山姓夏，雪都都姓萬，小板屋姓年，牛心山姓海，月落山姓宇，鹽井溪姓成，桃子溝姓平。

translations.literal: Baolinggang took the surname Gao, Ganshanping Ze, Ayeping Hui, Niudieman Zhou, Bajiaogou Hua, Longzhushan Xia, Xuedudu Wan, Xiaobanwu Nian, Niuxinshan Hai, Yueluoshan Yu, Yanjingxi Cheng, and Taozigou Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Baolinggang took the surname Gao, Ganshanping Ze, Ayeping Hui, Niudieman Zhou, Bajiaogou Hua, Longzhushan Xia, Xuedudu Wan, Xiaobanwu Nian, Niuxinshan Hai, Yueluoshan Yu, Yanjingxi Cheng, and Taozigou Ping.

sentences.zh: 赤夷十三支，嘉慶十三年，歸附，選拔土弁，給有委牌住牧。

translations.literal: The thirteen branches of Chiyi, in the 13th year of Jiaqing, submitted allegiance; native officers were selected and granted commission plaques to settle and pasture.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteen Chiyi branches submitted allegiance in the 13th year of Jiaqing; native officers were chosen and granted commissions to settle and pasture.

sentences.zh: 膽巴家土千總一、土把總一，管有雞疏、卑溪疏、哈疏、白魁四家。

translations.literal: The Danbajia had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander, governing four clans: Jishu, Beixishu, Hashu, and Baikui.
translations.idiomatic: The Danbajia clan had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander governing the Jishu, Beixishu, Hashu, and Baikui clans.

sentences.zh: 哈納家土千總一、土把總一，管有胃扭、雅劄、哈什三三家。

translations.literal: The Hanajia had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander, governing three clans: Weiniu, Yazha, and Hashisan.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanajia clan had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander governing the Weiniu, Yazha, and Hashisan clans.

sentences.zh: 蜚瓜家土千總一、土把總二，管有媽、呆得二家。

translations.literal: The Feiguajia had one native chiliarch and two native platoon commanders, governing two clans: Ma and Daide.
translations.idiomatic: The Feiguajia clan had one native chiliarch and two native platoon commanders governing the Ma and Daide clans.

sentences.zh: 魁西家土千總一、土把總一。

translations.literal: The Kuixijia had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuixijia clan had one native chiliarch and one native platoon commander.

sentences.zh: 凡各地支所部猓夷稱曰「娃子」。

translations.literal: All Nuosu Yi under the various branches were called "wazi."
translations.idiomatic: The Nuosu Yi subjects of the various branches were called wazi.

sentences.zh: 以上瓘邊廳瓘邊營冷磧汛屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Lengqi Garrison of the Guanbian Battalion of Guanbian Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Lengqi Garrison of the Guanbian Battalion of Guanbian Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 石砫宣慰使，其先馬定虎，漢馬援後。

translations.literal: Shizhu Pacification Commissioner; their forebear Ma Dinghu, descendant of the Han general Ma Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Shizhu descended from Ma Dinghu, a descendant of the Han general Ma Yuan.

sentences.zh: 南宋時，封安撫使。

translations.literal: In Southern Song times, enfeoffed as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Southern Song times the office was enfeoffed as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其後克用，明洪武初加封宣撫使。

translations.literal: Later Keyong, at the beginning of Hongwu of Ming, was further enfeoffed as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Later Keyong was elevated to Pacification Commissioner at the beginning of Hongwu.

sentences.zh: 崇禎時，土司千乘及婦秦良玉，以功加太子太保，封忠貞侯。

translations.literal: In Chongzhen times, the native chieftain Qiansheng and his wife Qin Liangyu, for merit, were promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen times chieftain Qiansheng and his wife Qin Liangyu were promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhongzhen for their service.

sentences.zh: 子祥麟，亦加封宣慰使。

translations.literal: His son Xianglin was also enfeoffed as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xianglin was also enfeoffed as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，祥麟子萬年歸附，仍授宣慰使職。

translations.literal: In the 16th year of Shunzhi, Xianglin's son Wannian submitted allegiance and was still granted the office of Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the 16th year of Shunzhi Xianglin's son Wannian submitted allegiance and retained the Pacification Commissioner office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，以夔州府分駐雲安廠同知移駐石砫。

translations.literal: In the 21st year of Qianlong, the subprefect of Yun'anchang stationed separately from Kuizhou Prefecture was moved to Shizhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the 21st year of Qianlong the Yun'anchang subprefect detached from Kuizhou Prefecture was relocated to Shizhu.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，設石砫直隸廳，改土宣慰使為土通判世職，不理民事。

translations.literal: In the 25th year, Shizhu Direct Subprefecture was established; the native Pacification Commissioner was changed to a hereditary native subprefect and did not manage civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the 25th year Shizhu Direct Subprefecture was established; the native Pacification Commissioner became a hereditary native subprefect without civil jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 夔州府夔州協屬。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Kuizhou Brigade of Kuizhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It fell under the Kuizhou Brigade of Kuizhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 酉陽宣慰使司，其先受明封。

translations.literal: Youyang Pacification Commissioner; their forebears received Ming enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Youyang had received Ming enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 傳至奇鑣，於順治十五年歸附，仍授原職，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Qibiao; in the 15th year of Shunzhi he submitted allegiance, was still granted his former office, and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Qibiao, who submitted allegiance in the 15th year of Shunzhi, retained his former office, and received seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年，土司元齡因事革職，以其地改設酉陽直隸州。

translations.literal: In the 12th year of Yongzheng, the native chieftain Yuanling was removed from office for cause and his territory was changed to Youyang Direct Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the 12th year of Yongzheng chieftain Yuanling was dismissed for cause and his domain became Youyang Direct Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 原管有邑梅峒、平茶峒、石耶峒、地壩四長官司，均於乾隆元年改流。

translations.literal: Originally it governed four native prefects of Yimeidong, Pingchadong, Shiyedong, and Diba; all were converted to regular administration in the 1st year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: It had originally governed the native prefects of Yimeidong, Pingchadong, Shiyedong, and Diba, all converted to direct rule in the 1st year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 重慶府綏甯營屬。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Suining Garrison of Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It fell under the Suining Garrison of Chongqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九姓土長官司，其先任福，江南溧陽人。

translations.literal: Jiuxing native prefect; their forebear Ren Fu, a native of Liyang in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Jiuxing descended from Ren Fu, a native of Liyang in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武初，從傅友德入蜀，招撫拗羿蠻，受封。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu of Ming, he followed Fu Youde into Shu, pacified the Aoyi tribes, and received enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu he followed Fu Youde into Sichuan, pacified the Aoyi tribes, and received enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 傳至孟麒，以功擢安撫使。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Mengqi, who for merit was promoted to Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Mengqi, who was promoted to Pacification Commissioner for distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，土司任世籓夫婦死難，子祈祿復以功授瀘衛守備。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Tianqi, the native chieftain Ren Shifan and his wife died in service; their son Qilu was again for merit granted garrison commander of Luwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Tianqi chieftain Ren Shifan and his wife died in service; their son Qilu received appointment as garrison commander of Luwei for distinguished service.

sentences.zh: 傳至長春，順治四年，歸附，更給知府劄副。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Changchun; in the 4th year of Shunzhi he submitted allegiance and was reissued a deputy prefect commission.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Changchun, who submitted allegiance in the 4th year of Shunzhi and received a new deputy prefect commission.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂叛，長春來奔。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui rebelled, Changchun came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui rebelled, Changchun fled to the Qing side.

sentences.zh: 十六年，復永甯，長春子功臣復率土民歸附，頒發劄付。

translations.literal: In the 16th year, when Yongning was recovered, Changchun's son Gongchen again led native people to submit allegiance and was issued a commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the 16th year, when Yongning was recovered, Changchun's son Gongchen again led his tribesmen to submit and received a commission.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，江安縣賊吳天成等作亂，功臣以擒賊功議敘。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Kangxi, the bandits Wu Tiancheng and others of Jiang'an County rebelled; Gongchen was recommended for reward for capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the 2nd year of Kangxi bandits led by Wu Tiancheng of Jiang'an County rebelled; Gongchen was recommended for reward for capturing them.

sentences.zh: 子宗頊襲職，隨頒土長官司印信號紙，以武職屬瀘州州判及瀘州營管轄。

translations.literal: His son Zongxu inherited the office and was then issued the seal and patent documents of native prefect; as a military office it was under the jurisdiction of the Luzhou subprefect and Luzhou Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongxu inherited the office and received the native prefect seal and patent documents; as a military post it fell under the Luzhou subprefect and Luzhou Garrison.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，移駐瀘衛。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Jiaqing, relocated to Luwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the 1st year of Jiaqing the post was relocated to Luwei.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，趙爾豐奏改瀘衛為古宋縣，存土司名。

translations.literal: In the 34th year of Guangxu, Zhao Erfeng memorialized to change Luwei to Gushong County while retaining the native chieftain title.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 Zhao Erfeng memorialized to convert Luwei into Gushong County while retaining the chieftain title.

sentences.zh: 瀘州瀘州營屬。

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Luzhou Garrison of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: It fell under the Luzhou Garrison of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 千萬貫土千總，其先自元時受封。

translations.literal: Qianwanguan native chiliarch; their forebears received enfeoffment from Yuan times.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Qianwanguan had received enfeoffment since Yuan times.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，賜姓楊。

translations.literal: In the 4th year of Hongwu of Ming, granted the surname Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the 4th year of Hongwu the Yang surname was granted.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十三年，土司楊喇哇歸附，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 43rd year of Kangxi, the native chieftain Yang Lawa submitted allegiance and was issued seal and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 43rd year of Kangxi chieftain Yang Lawa submitted allegiance and received seal and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 其後楊明義，於雍正六年因雲南米貼夷滋事案參革。

translations.literal: Later Yang Mingyi, in the 6th year of Yongzheng, was dismissed from office in connection with the Yunnan Mitie Yi disturbance case.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yang Mingyi was dismissed in the 6th year of Yongzheng in connection with the Mitie Yi disturbance in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 子明忠立功贖罪，賞土千總職銜，未經請頒印信號紙。

translations.literal: His son Mingzhong atoned for the offense through merit and was rewarded with the title of native chiliarch, but no seal or patent documents were requested and issued.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingzhong redeemed the offense through service and received the native chiliarch title, though no seal or patent documents were issued.

sentences.zh: 管有頭目六十五名。

translations.literal: It governed sixty-five headmen.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised sixty-five headmen.

sentences.zh: 千萬貫土千戶，其先楊繼武，為土千總楊成胞叔。

translations.literal: Qianwanguan native chiliarch; their forebear Yang Jiwu was the paternal uncle of native chiliarch Yang Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Qianwanguan descended from Yang Jiwu, paternal uncle of native chiliarch Yang Cheng.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年，夷人滋事，繼武同成出力，賞給土千戶執照。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Jiaqing, when the Yi caused disturbances, Jiwu together with Cheng exerted effort and was rewarded with a native chiliarch license.
translations.idiomatic: In the 7th year of Jiaqing, when the Yi rebelled, Jiwu and Cheng served with distinction and Jiwu received a native chiliarch license.

sentences.zh: 千萬貫土巡檢，其先安濟，明時授馬湖土知府。

translations.literal: Qianwanguan native inspector; their forebear An Ji, in Ming times granted native prefect of Mahu.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Qianwanguan descended from An Ji, who in Ming times received appointment as native prefect of Mahu.

sentences.zh: 其後失職，復授土巡檢。

translations.literal: Later the office was lost and he was again granted native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The office was later lost and restored as native inspector.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，土舍安保歸附，無印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Yongzheng, the native tusu An Bao submitted allegiance; no seal or patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 6th year of Yongzheng native tusu An Bao submitted allegiance but held no seal or patent documents.

sentences.zh: 管有頭目二十四名。

translations.literal: It governed twenty-four headmen.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction comprised twenty-four headmen.

sentences.zh: 以上雷波廳普安營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Pu'an Garrison of Leibo Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Pu'an Garrison of Leibo Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 黃螂土舍，其先為明時酋長。

translations.literal: Huanglang native tusu; their forebears were chieftains in Ming times.
translations.idiomatic: The native tusu of Huanglang descended from Ming-era chieftains.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，土舍國保歸附，無印信號紙。

translations.literal: In the 5th year of Yongzheng, the native tusu Guobao submitted allegiance; no seal or patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the 5th year of Yongzheng native tusu Guobao submitted allegiance but held no seal or patent documents.

sentences.zh: 凡千萬貫、黃螂四土司，所管黑、白骨頭二種倮夷，椎髻衣氈，耕種打牲為業。

translations.literal: All four native chieftains of Qianwanguan and Huanglang governed two kinds of Nuosu Yi, black-headed and white-headed; they wore topknots and felt garments and made their living by farming and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: The four chieftains of Qianwanguan and Huanglang governed black-headed and white-headed Nuosu Yi who wore topknots and felt garments and lived by farming and hunting.

sentences.zh: 以上雷波廳安阜營屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Anfu Garrison of Leibo Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Anfu Garrison of Leibo Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 平彝長官司，其先王元壽，原籍江南人，於明時受封。

translations.literal: Pingyi native prefect; their forebear Wang Yuanshou, originally a native of Jiangnan, received enfeoffment in Ming times.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Pingyi descended from Wang Yuanshou, a Jiangnan native enfeoffed in Ming times.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，土司王長才歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Wang Changcai submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi chieftain Wang Changcai submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 蠻彝司長官司，其先文的保，原籍湖廣人，於明時受封。

translations.literal: Manyisi native prefect; their forebear Wen Debao, originally a native of Huguang, received enfeoffment in Ming times.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Manyisi descended from Wen Debao, a Huguang native enfeoffed in Ming times.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，土司文鳳鳴歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Wen Fengming submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi chieftain Wen Fengming submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 泥溪長官司，其先王麒，自明時世襲。

translations.literal: Nixi native prefect; their forebear Wang Qi had held the office hereditarily since Ming times.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Nixi descended from Wang Qi, who had held the office by hereditary succession since Ming times.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，土司王嗣傳歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Wang Sichuan submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi chieftain Wang Sichuan submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 沐川長官司，其先於明時受封，賜姓悅。

translations.literal: Muchuan native prefect; their forebears received enfeoffment in Ming times and were granted the surname Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Muchuan had received Ming enfeoffment and the surname Yue.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，土司悅嶢瞻歸附。

translations.literal: In the 9th year of Shunzhi, the native chieftain Yue Yaozhan submitted allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the 9th year of Shunzhi chieftain Yue Yaozhan submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆頒有印信號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains were issued seals and patent documents.

sentences.zh: 以上屏山縣屏山汛屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Pingshan Garrison of Pingshan County.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Pingshan Garrison of Pingshan County.

sentences.zh: 明州樂土百戶，其先盔甲，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Mingzhoule native centurion; their forebear Kuijia, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Mingzhoule descended from Kuijia, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 其後駱哥，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: Later Luoge, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Later Luoge submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 油石洞土百戶，其先普祚，涼山生夷。

translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Youshidong descended from Puzuo, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son Jugu, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jugu submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

translations.literal: His son Luosu, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luosu submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 大羊腸土百戶，其先六盔，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Dayangchang native centurion; their forebear Liukui, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Dayangchang descended from Liukui, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 子紐車，康熙四十二年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: His son Niuche, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Niuche submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 膩乃巢土百戶，其先必祚，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Ninaichao native centurion; their forebear Bizuo, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Ninaichao descended from Bizuo, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son Jiaogu, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jiaogu submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上馬邊廳馬邊營煙峰汛屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Yanfeng Garrison of the Mabian Battalion of Mabian Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Yanfeng Garrison of the Mabian Battalion of Mabian Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 挖黑土百戶，其先亦赤，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Wahei native centurion; their forebear Yichi, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Wahei descended from Yichi, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son San'er, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son San'er submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 阿招土百戶，其先阿直，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Azhao native centurion; their forebear Azhi, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Azhao descended from Azhi, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son Yangge, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yangge submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 幹田壩土百戶，其先賒的，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Gantianba native centurion; their forebear Shedi, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Gantianba descended from Shedi, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son Luyin, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luyin submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 麻柳壩土百戶，其先鄂車，涼山生夷。

translations.idiomatic: The native centurion of Maliuba descended from Eche, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

translations.literal: His son Liugui, in the 42nd year of Kangxi, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Liugui submitted allegiance in the 42nd year of Kangxi and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司，皆領有號紙。

translations.literal: All the above native chieftains held patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: All the above native chieftains held patent documents.

sentences.zh: 㯕栗坪土千戶，其先卜佐，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Biliping native chiliarch; their forebear Buzuo, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch of Biliping descended from Buzuo, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 其後阿二，嘉慶十三年，歸附，賞給職銜，領有委牌。

translations.literal: Later A'er, in the 13th year of Jiaqing, submitted allegiance, was rewarded with an office title, and held a commission plaque.
translations.idiomatic: Later A'er submitted allegiance in the 13th year of Jiaqing, received an office title, and held a commission plaque.

sentences.zh: 冷紀土外委，其先普祚，涼山生夷。

translations.literal: Lengji native ensign; their forebear Puzuo, raw tribes of Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The native ensign of Lengji descended from Puzuo, a raw tribe of Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 子未鐵，雍正元年，歸附，授職。

translations.literal: His son Weitie, in the 1st year of Yongzheng, submitted allegiance and received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His son Weitie submitted allegiance in the 1st year of Yongzheng and received appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上馬邊廳馬邊營三河口汛屬。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Sanhekou Garrison of the Mabian Battalion of Mabian Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The above fell under the Sanhekou Garrison of the Mabian Battalion of Mabian Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 以上各土司外，有理番廳之雜穀腦屯、乾堡寨屯、上孟董屯、下董孟屯、九子寨屯，懋功廳之懋功屯、崇化屯、撫邊屯、章穀屯、綏靖屯等土弁，各設屯守備，暨所屬屯千總、屯把總、屯外委，均世及接頂，與地志、兵志互見。

translations.literal: Beyond all the above native chieftains, there were native officers of the Zagunnao, Ganbaozhai, Upper Mengdong, Lower Dongmeng, and Jiuzizhai garrisons of Lifan Subprefecture, and the Maogong, Chonghua, Fubian, Zhanggu, and Suijing garrisons of Maogong Subprefecture; each garrison had a garrison commander, together with subordinate garrison chiliarchs, garrison platoon commanders, and garrison ensigns, all hereditary by succession, as cross-referenced in the gazetteers of geography and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these chieftains were the garrison native officers of Zagunnao, Ganbaozhai, Upper Mengdong, Lower Dongmeng, and Jiuzizhai in Lifan Subprefecture, and Maogong, Chonghua, Fubian, Zhanggu, and Suijing in Maogong Subprefecture—each with a garrison commander and subordinate chiliarchs, platoon commanders, and ensigns, all hereditary offices cross-referenced in the gazetteers of geography and military affairs.
